articles.headline: Elon Musk Is So Rich The President Would Need To Hold Office For 2.37 Million Years To Catch Up
articles.summary: A look at the wealth of Elon Musk compared to the salary of the president of the United States.
articles._summary: Here’s a look at how Musk’s wealth compares to the annual salary of one of the top jobs in America, the president of the United States. Musk’s net worth is so large that sometimes crazy comparisons like him being able to buy every MLB, NBA, NFL and NHL team combined have to be used to put the large amounts into perspective. Bloomberg currently ranks Musk first with a wealth of $947 billion, with a gain of $328 billion in 2026, thanks in large part to SpaceX.

articles.author: Namrata Sen
articles.headline: Before BlackRock Became Untouchable, Carl Icahn Told Larry Fink His $4.8 Trillion Empire Was Protecting Bad CEOs— And He Had a $9 Billion Example to Prove It
articles.summary: Carl Icahn blasted Larry Fink and BlackRock in 2015, accusing the asset manager of protecting Motorola's management over shareholders.
articles._summary: Icahn also argued that BlackRock’s immense influence, managing about $4.8 trillion at the time, allowed it to protect entrenched management teams instead of supporting shareholder-driven reforms. “….you use it to protect these guys as long as they do what you want,” said Icahn. While emphasizing that he respected Fink personally, Icahn said BlackRock’s voting practices were “very dangerous” for U.S. capital markets because they discouraged accountability and meaningful corporate change.
articles._zh_headline: 在贝莱德变得铁面无私之前，卡尔·伊坎告诉拉里·芬克，他的 4.8 万亿美元帝国正在保护糟糕的首席执行官——他有一个 90 亿美元的例子来证明这一点
articles._zh_summary: 伊坎还认为，贝莱德的巨大影响力（当时管理着约 4.8 万亿美元）使其能够保护根深蒂固的管理团队，而不是支持股东驱动的改革。 “......你用它来保护这些人，只要他们做你想做的事，”伊坎说。伊坎强调他个人尊重芬克，但他表示贝莱德的投票做法对美国资本市场“非常危险”，因为它们不利于问责制和有意义的企业变革。

articles.author: Ananya Gairola
articles.headline: Meta Pulls AI Image Feature After Privacy Backlash, Admits It 'Missed the Mark' Amid SAG-AFTRA Criticism
articles.summary: Meta discontinued its AI image-generation feature just days after launch, admitting it "missed the mark" following privacy backlash.
articles._summary: The tool, integrated into the Meta AI chatbot, allowed users to generate and edit AI-created images using public Instagram photos as input. Critics, however, argued the feature was enabled by default rather than requiring users to opt in. “Our intent was to provide a useful creative tool and to give people control over whether their public content could be referenced in this way,” Meta said in a statement.
articles._zh_headline: Meta 在隐私强烈反对后撤回了 AI 图像功能，在 SAG-AFTRA 批评中承认它“没有达到目标”
articles._zh_summary: 该工具集成到 Meta AI 聊天机器人中，允许用户使用 Instagram 公开照片作为输入来生成和编辑人工智能创建的图像。然而，批评者认为该功能是默认启用的，而不是要求用户选择加入。“我们的目的是提供一个有用的创意工具，并让人们控制是否可以通过这种方式引用他们的公共内容，”Meta 在一份声明中表示。

articles.headline: ServiceNow Stock Falls Friday: What's Going On?

articles._summary: The latest narrative centers on Accenture’s rollout of two AI-focused offerings built on ServiceNow’s AI Platform: managed security services and an AI-powered automation solution aimed at lowering the cost and complexity of modernizing enterprise risk and security operations. The stock has also been riding a friendlier tone after a July 1 upgrade to Buy that argued software valuations were pricing in "extinction," framing the pullback as a better entry.

articles.headline: Apple Accuses OpenAI of Using Job Interviews to Extract its Hardware Secrets in New Lawsuit
articles.summary: Apple sues OpenAI for trade secret theft. Lawsuits raise concerns over AI ethics and user privacy as publishers seek court sanctions.
articles._summary: Editor’s Note: This story has been updated with industry reaction, additional details and a statement from OpenAI. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL ) sued OpenAI in federal court in Northern California on Friday, accusing the AI company of taking Apple’s trade secrets to accelerate its own push into consumer devices. The complaint lands as publishers seek court sanctions against OpenAI in a separate Manhattan case tied to what they allege were misleading statements about tracking copyrighted material inside its systems.

articles._summary: For decades, investors used index funds to diversify away company-specific risks. The filing comes at a time when Musk’s footprint across passive portfolios is expanding rapidly. Tesla has been a member of the S&P 500 since 2020 and the Nasdaq-100 since 2013.

articles.headline: Standard Chartered Keeps $100,000 Bitcoin Target, Calls Strategy Selloff a 'Communication Challenge'
articles.summary: Standard Chartered has reaffirmed its $100,000 year-end 2026 target for Bitcoin, arguing that recent weakness tied to Strategy reflects a communication challenge, not a deterioration in its financial position. Investors are adjusting to Strategy's transition from a "never sell Bitcoin" model to using BTC as collateral for its preferred stock business.
articles._summary: In a research note on Friday, Geoffrey Kendrick , Standard Chartered’s global head of digital assets research said, “I see what is happening at MSTR right now as a communication challenge, nothing more,” He argued that investors are still adjusting to Strategy’s shift away from its long-standing “never sell Bitcoin” philosophy toward using Bitcoin as collateral to support its growing preferred stock business.
